prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Katy, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1118; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recording is for claim file purposes. Do you understand and consent to being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you tell me in your own words what happened at the intersection in Katy?

A: I was turning left off the main road into the shopping center. I had my signal on and I was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic. When it looked clear, I started my turn, and then a car coming from the other direction hit the front driver's side of my vehicle.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you began the turn?

A: I saw headlights a ways off, but it seemed far enough away that I had time to go. I guess I misjudged the speed.

Q: Was anything blocking your view at that point?

A: There was a large delivery truck in the right lane stopped near the crosswalk, so I had to pull out a little to see past it.

Q: Where do you feel injured?

A: My right knee took the brunt of it. It hit the dashboard when the airbag went off. It's swollen and I have trouble bending it past a certain point.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or gone to an urgent care since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care the same day, and they took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic specialist. I have an appointment scheduled.

Q: Is there anything you would like to add or correct in your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get my car repaired and get my knee taken care of.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the recorded statement.
